mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet (member_id, name, species, breed, birth_date, gender, weight, neutered, reg_number, medical_history) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{weight}, #{neutered}, #{regNumber}, #{medicalHistory})
mapper.update: UPDATE pet SET name = #{name}, species = #{species}, breed = #{breed}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, weight = #{weight}, neutered = #{neutered}, reg_number = #{regNumber}, medical_history = #{medicalHistory}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId}
UPDATE pet SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId}
